messages:
IncidentBot: :rotating_light: PROD ALERT: high-5xx-rate on /v1/generate (west1). Pager triggered for P1. Alert ID: ALERT-2026-07-21-5912
Alex Chen: I'm on the tail end of my shift, hitting the bridge now. looks like a sudden spike, increasing tail latency + error rate. I'll grab initial triage, but FYI I'm handing off in ~12m.
Maria Diaz: @Alex Chen thanks — I'm coming online in 10. If you need a takeover, I can be primary driver.
Alex Chen: @Maria Diaz that would be great. current state: ~30% 5xx, errors look like downstream grpc pool exhaustion from model-hosting. Runbook link: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/5xx-spike
Alex Chen: Quick checks I ran: `kubectl logs -n inference gateway-xyz | grep ERR | tail -n 50` showed repeated "connection reset by peer" to model-pool. Also CPU on host-gpu-12 is normal.
Priya Patel: I'm available for comms if needed. I can post updates to status and support channel.
Maria Diaz: OK taking driver role. Alex — can you transfer any in-flight notes? anything in the bridge?
Alex Chen: Pushing a short handoff:
- Suspected root: model-backend grpc connection saturation from a slow rollout (maybe a new model shard).
- Mitigations tried: scaled model deployment from 4->6 pods (no immediate effect), restarted a flapping pod (temporarily reduced errors for ~30s).
- Customer impact: token generation timeouts, some requests returning 502. No data exfiltration. Estimated % requests affected: 2.5% globally, higher in west1 (~7%).
- Next checks: check model-hosting resource metrics, tail latencies in the last 5m, and recent deploys in the last 30m.
Maria Diaz: Got it. I'll confirm deploy history and check model-hosting autoscaler. Priya — can you draft the first customer-facing note with: "We are investigating increased 5xx errors affecting text generation in west1; engineers are investigating. No data exposure." Keep it short.
Priya Patel: On it. Drafting: "We are investigating increased 5xx errors affecting text generation in west1. Our team is actively investigating and mitigating. We'll post updates every 15 minutes or sooner." Will post to #status once you confirm.
Sam O'Neill: Heads up — I'm covering APAC follow-ups. If you end up failing over traffic to another region, we need to confirm capacity. Also check if any scheduled maintenance overlapped.
Maria Diaz: Good call. I'm checking deploys: `kubectl -n hosting get rs --selector=app=model-backend --sort-by=.metadata.creationTimestamp | tail -n 5` — nothing obvious but there was a rollout 25m ago for model-shard-v2.
Maria Diaz: I'm going to rollback that shard in a canary to see if errors drop. Will do a canary rollback on one host first.
Alex Chen: Recommend capturing timeline in the incident doc: https://redwood.internal/incidents/ALERT-2026-07-21-5912. I added the initial diagnostics under "triage notes".
Maria Diaz: Doing the canary rollback now: `kubectl rollout undo deployment/model-shard-v2 -n hosting --to-revision=3` (will do on host-group west1-canary).
IncidentBot: Deploy bot: deployment/model-shard-v2 rollback started by maria via console at 1729456530.
Maria Diaz: rollback applied to canary. Observing metrics...
Maria Diaz: Error rate on canary-hosts dropped from 22% -> 1.8% within 60s. Looks promising.
Alex Chen: Nice. If canary is stable for 5m, promote rollback to remainder of west1.
Maria Diaz: Will wait 3m for stability then promote. Priya, please hold status update until I confirm results, then post with mitigation note.
Priya Patel: Copy. Holding. Draft updated to include rollback test pending.
Sam O'Neill: I kicked off capacity pre-checks for east1 and apac. east1 has ~30% spare infer capacity; apac low on spare GPUs (10%). If we failover, apac might see degraded latency.
Maria Diaz: Promoting rollback to west1 full at 1729457001.
IncidentBot: Deploy bot: rollback promoted to deployment/model-shard-v2 at 1729457001.
Maria Diaz: After full rollback, 5xx rate in west1 now 0.9% (baseline ~0.3%). Latencies normalized.
Alex Chen: Excellent. Status: mitigation applied (rollback), error rate back near baseline, ongoing observation. I'm formally handing driver to @Maria Diaz. I will remain available for followups for the next 1h as secondary.
Maria Diaz: Thanks Alex. I'll take driver. Priya, please post the customer update now with mitigation note and expected update cadence.
Priya Patel: Posted to #status and sent to Support with link to incident doc. Message: "Mitigation: rolled back recent model shard rollout in west1. Error rates returning to normal. Engineers are monitoring; updates every 15 minutes."
Alex Chen: A few ops tasks for after shift: annotate incident with the exact pod IDs that flapped, attach logs, and follow up with model team to prevent repeat.
Maria Diaz: Adding action items to incident doc. Also flagging model-team for postmortem and to check rollout health checks. @Sam O'Neill can you take point on APAC capacity planning?
Sam O'Neill: Yep will coordinate with infra to pre-stage capacity if needed.
Priya Patel: I'm updating the support ticket with mitigation summary and ETA for next update.
Maria Diaz: Ok handoff complete. Driver: Maria Diaz. Comms: Priya Patel. Secondary: Alex Chen. Coverage note: small APAC gap acknowledged, Sam will coordinate.
Alex Chen: Thanks team. I'll sign off now — good job. :thumbsup:
Maria Diaz: Thanks all, I'll stay on for 45m to ensure stability then add postmortem owners.
Priya Patel: Closing loop with customer-facing channels in 15.
IncidentBot: Incident ALERT-2026-07-21-5912 transitioned to MONITORING at 1729457399.
Maria Diaz: Marking thread resolved for active mitigation; keeping doc open for postmortem assignment.
Alex Chen: Logged final handoff note and closing my shift.
Priya Patel: Noted. Thanks.
Maria Diaz: Last message before I drop: who gets the follow-up PM? I'm assigning to @michael (model team) in the doc.
Alex Chen: Sounds good. Make sure to request the rollout gating improvements.
Maria Diaz: Will do. End of thread.
